title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: important changes in PTE management.
summary: The Business Central Admin Center is gaining new PTE management capabilities, allowing administrators to upload, schedule installation, and uninstall per-tenant extensions directly. Starting in version 30 (2027 wave 1), the Extension Management page will no longer support PTE installation and will be limited to viewing only.
key_points: Administrators can now upload PTEs and schedule their installation via the Admin Center's Manage Apps page, with flexible deployment timing options
PTE installations can be scheduled immediately, during the next update window, or during minor/major updates, with database sync mode options available
Only users with Dynamics 365 Business Central Administrator or Dynamics 365 Administrator roles can access the Admin Center for PTE management
Version 30 (2027 wave 1) will remove PTE installation from the Extension Management page, leaving it for viewing only
A new Admin Center API version 2.29 enables programmatic PTE installation and scheduling
